From visit to signed tenancy

Same discipline as a well-run lodge, productised for many owners. Fees are whatever that lodge configured — Gida never invents a price.

  1. Step 1

    Owner onboarding

    Create organisation, upload KYC, add payout banks. Listing stays private.

  2. Step 2

    Platform verification

    Gida staff approve or request more info. Only then can you publish.

  3. Step 3

    Browse or visit

    Seekers see verified lodges only. Walk-ins meet the caretaker.

  4. Step 4

    Token

    Caretaker confirms the token fee (your amount) and issues a one-time code.

  5. Step 5

    Apply & terms

    Applicant creates an account, reads YOUR tenancy terms before paying rent.

  6. Step 6

    Pay & receipt

    Transfer to the lodge account shown in the portal — not the token account.

  7. Step 7

    Documents & surety

    NIN optional, school/work, guarantor. Honesty policy you configure.

  8. Step 8

    Sign

    Agreement filled with room, dates and the rent you published.

  9. Step 9

    Dual approval

    Caretaker then owner. PDF issued. Occupancy updates.

  10. Step 10

    Live tenancy

    Renewals, tickets, caution ledger, parent payments.
